excerpts.text: A payment method is required to sign up for a free trial. When the trial ends, your paid subscription starts, unless it has been canceled before.
After the scan completes, you can review the amount of space taken up by unnecessary files and select which files you want to remove from your Mac.
Find duplicates detects multiple files with identical content.
Analyze photos detects photos that are blurry, badly lit, or similar.
Uninstall apps allows you to easily find and remove applications from your Mac that you no longer use.
Review the list of applications, launch agents, and launch daemons.
Scanning: Specify scan options for Cleaning clutter, Finding duplicates, Finding photos, and Uninstalling apps, or allow System Monitor.
Trash: Enable to automatically delete files from the Trash after a specific time.
Privacy: Manage which app-usage data you want to share.
Notify me when my disk space is less than: Tick or untick this option to enable or disable notifications about the amount of free disk space on your Mac.
If you installed AVG TuneUp but you have not subscribed to or activated the app following your subscription purchase, the application runs in scan-only mode and cannot clean anything.
Activate AVG TuneUp using the activation code from your order confirmation email.
Each time you remove files, photos, or applications using AVG TuneUp, you are asked to authorize the cleaning process by entering the password that you use when you start your Mac.
Quick Clean scans your Mac for unnecessary files and allows you to select which files are deleted to clear disk space.
Select none: Deselects all listed file categories. You can then manually select the file categories you want to clean.
Click the panel for a browser to review and adjust the items that AVG TuneUp has permission to remove during each scan.
The selected website is now excluded from cookie clearing.
Keep oldest: Automatically selects the newest version of each file for removal.
Keep newest: Automatically selects the oldest version of each file for removal.
Select none: Deselects all files and allows you to manually select files for removal.
AVG TuneUp Premium for Mac is a paid app that requires a subscription to use.
Double-click the downloaded setup file avgtuneup.dmg.
AVG TuneUp is now installed, but some components may not fully function until you restart your Mac.
